bug_semantics: CWE-639: CRUDComponent::edit() loaded a record by the route id then patchEntity()/save() with the full request body. CakePHP 4 EntityTrait defaults $_accessible to ['*' => true], so an unguarded id in the body could retarget the UPDATE onto another row of the same type. Entities that never set 'id' => false (User, Role, UserSetting, LocalTool, PermissionLimitation, EnumerationCollection, and AppModel itself) were exposed; UserSettings::edit was reachable by any authenticated user. Cerebrate 1.37 strips id after beforeMarshal in edit()/add() and sets AppModel $_accessible id => false.
flaw_origin: 62c9050fb2c5fb0d351594dec8bbec645860940b (iglocska, 2020-06-09) first added CRUDComponent with edit() doing Table->get($id) then patchEntity($data, $this->request->getData()) and save() with no id strip. Parent dccf9d5fd6c1ad13d5983a5c13ef41456551aa71 has no CRUDComponent path (only ACL/RestResponse components). AppModel was an empty Entity subclass; CakePHP 4.0.3 EntityTrait default is $_accessible=['*' => true], so id was marshallable. Later 7159034e/aff1ca70 only guarded add(), not edit(); 44c60942 is a path move; UserSettings (39fdb8ec) is a later reachable surface, not the first write of the unguarded edit marshalling.
